lines.text: Many learners say: Please teach me your phone number.
Better: Please tell me your phone number.
Teach is for lessons. Use tell for a number.
Tell! Please tell me your phone number.

native.tip: teach は勉強や技術を教えるとき。番号や場所を教えるときは tell。
native.caption: “Please teach me your phone number.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語の「教える」を何でも teach にしてしまいがちです。“Please tell me your phone number.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“tell”。“Please tell me your phone number.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Use tell for numbers and names.
en.caption: Do you say this? “Please teach me your phone number.” 😅 Teach is for lessons, not for a number. The natural way is “Please tell me your phone number.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
